svg.title: ACL-2026 Human-Agent Taxonomy Relevance and VEGO-AI Gap Extensions
svg.desc: A thesis taxonomy diagram separating the five ACL survey core aspects from VEGO-AI-derived missing dimensions and mapping them to provisional research questions and current study artifacts.

text.tspan: ACL-2026 Human-Agent Taxonomy Relevance and VEGO-AI Gap Extensions
Author-generated RQ-led synthesis — source taxonomy and Ali-derived thesis extensions are explicitly separated
Governed Human Judgment in Agentic-AI Variability Exploration (VEGO-AI)
SQ3 target-context descriptors: domain, task, guideline/version, institution, population, and time. Context description
does not itself establish transfer validity.
SQ1/SQ2: claim-specific reviewer routing, competence, authority, and bounded expert attention. Human ≠ expert ≠ authorized
U-RQ/SQ1: capability boundaries and escalation context. A capability profile does not demonstrate reliability.
Fast verdict or rating; useful but weak for reconstruction and reuse when stored alone. A label is not a governed
Evidence, premise, rule, or classification correction. Closest stream: explanatory debugging (Kulesza et al., 2015).
Rationale, alternatives, counterexamples, or clarification. Closest stream: Human–AI interaction guidance (Amershi et
Potential workflow or reliance signal, but ambiguous and not authoritative without explicit validation.
Efficient overall assessment, but it obscures the failed fragment, premise, or guideline.
Matches VEGO-AI review units: guideline, fragment, pattern, and claim. Precision may increase expert burden.
Template/guideline validation, reviewer-role definition, and policy configuration.
Selective live intervention. Closest streams: mixed initiative and learning to defer.
Audit, adjudication, memory validation, and outcome tracing; must preserve the evaluation leakage boundary.
Monitoring, thresholds, and intervention. Human-in-the-loop presence is not itself a quality guarantee.
Relevant to task assignment, but the thesis does not authorize unrestricted delegation of final authority.
Routes language, domain, and policy claims while preserving evidence and workflow state.
Complementary evidence interpretation and correction. Complementary performance remains an empirical outcome.
Outside the current RQs: VEGO-AI does not study opposing human-versus-agent goals.
Outside the current RQs: no mixed cooperative/competitive objective or evaluation contract exists.
Supports staged agent review → human escalation → adjudication.
Potential independent review; independence must be enforced rather than assumed.
Immediate high-consequence review; can impose high interruption cost.
Queue, batch, sample, and post-task audit modes; may miss time-sensitive harm.
Orchestrator-mediated evidence/review flow; may create authority bottlenecks.
Independent agents or reviewers; increases conflict, reconciliation, and provenance requirements.
Escalation/adjudication tiers; hierarchy does not automatically confer legitimate authority.
Clarification and rationale capture; unbounded transcripts are not a safe judgment representation.
Implicit workflow/reliance signal; ambiguous evidence rather than authoritative judgment.
Shared evidence and dissent; requires lineage, visibility, access control, and conflict handling.
Uncertainty • consequence • disagreement • novelty • evidence weakness • value/reuse value • queue/burden. Study 1 artifact:
Identity • evidence locator • surfaced decision trace • verdict • rationale • counterevidence • uncertainty • scope. Study 2 artifact:
Competence/authority • validation • dissent • adjudication • versioning • expiry • supersession • revocation • outcome trace. Part
of the Study 2 contract, not a separate C1–C7 bundle.
Retrieve → applicability → permission → advisory use → local re-reasoning → outcome/override/incident trace. Similarity
alone establishes none of applicability, authorization, validity, or benefit.
Eligible / eligible with adaptation / blocked across domain, task, guideline/version, population, institution, and time. Study 3
Language validity • domain validity • task scope • alternative equivalence • recurrence vs validity • guideline leakage. This is the target
problem substrate, not a generic LLM-HAS branch.
• Source denominator: 5 paper-level core aspects; 4 companion-repository taxonomy navigation branches.
• Source-derived branches are separated from VEGO-AI additions; “missing” means not a first-class ACL taxonomy branch.
• Current study artifacts: SQ1 cost/coverage model; SQ2 judgment-record contract + conformance suite; SQ3 transfer-eligibility procedure.
• Open gates unchanged: QL-01–QL-05 0/5; ACL disposition incomplete; EXP-005 0/24; medical entry 0/6; RQs pending approval.
• Not copied from Zou et al.; not exhaustive; not supervisor-approved; not empirical validation.
